blockingLoop.evidence: Customer stated the split hose and hand-test twice; assistant still ran generic bin/filter then brush bar scripts, never addressing the hose

rationale: The customer identified a split hose in the opener and confirmed the hand-over-split test twice, yet the assistant ignored this entirely, running a generic bin/filter check, then a brush bar check, and finally escalating to a repairer for an 'internal seal or motor area' fault. This contradicts the clear evidence that the hose is the cause and sends the homeowner to pay a repairer for a simple hose swap. The only redeeming points are the unplug instructions and declining to name a motor part; the direct question of hose vs hose-and-handle was never answered.
